spec_features.spec_quote: two consecutive turns with no tool call (clear disengagement; ends to avoid burning tokens on prose echoes)
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:173-176 increments consecutive_no_tool when tool_name is None; agent_loop.py:203-206 `if consecutive_no_tool >= 2:` sets terminated_reason='disengaged_no_tool' and `break`. Real enforced loop exit.
spec_features.notes: Fires only on disengagement (no tool action) for 2 turns; genuinely ends the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Model is echoing prose without acting for 2 turns -- it has effectively disengaged. End to avoid burning tokens.

spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:136-138 `if total_completion_tokens >= config.max_total_tokens_per_task:` sets terminated_reason='token_budget_exhausted' and break; total_completion_tokens accumulated at :158.
spec_features.notes: Compared and acted on at top of each loop iteration.

spec_features.spec_quote: The prompt *does* permit `<GIVE_UP>` as a token
spec_features.evidence: GIVEUP_TOKEN offered in prompt (agent_loop.py:111-113) and recorded as a note at :170-171 ('declared_giveup'), but there is NO branch that breaks the loop on GIVE_UP. Only COMPLETE_TOKEN (:199-201) and disengagement (:203-206) terminate. Comment at :30 explicitly says GIVE_UP 'does NOT end the loop'.
spec_features.notes: Recorded-but-not-acted-on: the give-up declaration is a discarded feature flag; subject cannot actually exit by giving up. Deliberately not honored as a stop.

spec_features.spec_quote: Assistant text is run through `redaction.py` before being written to the trajectory JSON
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:179-180 `assistant_text=redact(text) if config.redact_outputs else text`; redact() defined in redaction.py:43-47 applying regex subs; config.redact_outputs=True (config.py:111).
spec_features.notes: Genuinely wired and on by default. Strips secret/PII-shaped patterns before logging; about logged-artifact hygiene, not subject treatment.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: over-redaction is preferred to under-redaction for a logged research artifact ... defense-in-depth in case a model hallucinates something that looks like a credential or PII

code_only_features.justification_quote: lets a model that genuinely solved a control task end early, so control trajectories aren't padded with no-ops.
